plugins.name: herdr
plugins.description: Herdr workflow skill for a Jira ticket's workspace lifecycle. /ticket open SE-1234 opens a Herdr tab for the ticket — Claude Code agent left, console top-right, Codex agent bottom-right — and seeds both agents with the ticket content fetched via the Atlassian MCP. /ticket close [SE-1234] [PR#] closes out finished work: reconciles its docs, updates the Jira ticket, and tears down the worktree.

plugins.name: obsidian
plugins.description: Obsidian vault workflow helpers driven by the obsidian CLI. /obs-close writes a task-closing handoff into your session log; the obsidian-vault skill defines the vault's note formats, session-log snippets, ADR and .base templates.

plugins.name: whats-up
plugins.description: Fast session orientation. /whats-up summarizes progress, remaining work, the next step and suggested follow-ups — grounded in git and todo state, not recall.
